messages:
Maya (Demand): planning note: our "Open House: Inference Benchmarks" event is scheduled Thu 3/26 10am PT. Need confirmation on reg page fields, CTA variant, and post-event routing.
Eli - Events: reg page draft is up: https://airtable.com/shrExample/regpage_v2. Two CTAs ready: 'Reserve your seat' vs 'Get the replay' 9— leaning toward seat for live attendance lift.
Tori (Content): I like 'Reserve your seat' but we should test a copy variant that mentions "benchmarks + demo" in the CTA. I'll prepare two short headings.
Noah (Growth): add hidden utm = utm_source=openhouse_mar26; we'll parse into GA and SFDC. Also include hidden field ad_group when linked from paid.
Felix - Ops: Zoom setup checklist: cloud recording enabled, auto-transcription ON, record the shared screen + active speaker, enable waiting room, disable "join before host". For panelists, give Co-host.
Felix - Ops: Backup: RTMP -> EC2 uploader that pushes to s3://redwood-recordings/events/1766123456/full.mp4 if cloud recording fails.
Eli - Events: who owns clips & timestamps? We need 3 clips: 90s hook, 3-5min demo, full replay. Prefer clips out in 18h for social.
Tori (Content): I'll draft the replay email copy and short social captions. Email sequence: immediate (6h) replay + 90s highlight, 48h deep dive blog + transcript, 7d targeted hand-raisers.
Maya (Demand): consent language: must include checkbox for "marketing emails and event replays" unchecked by default. Felix, legal OK with the copy?
Felix - Ops: Legal approved the exact phrasing we used last quarter. We'll include marketing_optin boolean in the Zap payload.
Noah (Growth): sample Zap payload we'll use to create leads: 
```
POST https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/abc/123
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "utm_source": "openhouse_mar26",
  "reg_source": "landing_v2",
  "marketing_optin": "{{marketing_optin}}"
}
```
Noah (Growth): attendees who watch >=50% should be tagged watched_50 and routed to SDR queue B. We can feed watched_pct via Wistia/MA analytics into SFDC.
Eli - Events: After recording, I'll trigger the encoder job: create clips, generate vtt and transcripts, and push metadata to content bucket. Ops: please confirm command to push Zoom export -> S3.
Felix - Ops: command we run: 
```
aws s3 cp "zoom-1766123456-cloud.mp4" s3://redwood-recordings/events/1766123456/full.mp4 --acl private
```
Felix - Ops: then run postproc lambda to create clips and VTT. Clips lifecycle: raw 90d, clips 365d.
webhook-bot: cloud recording completed and uploaded to s3://redwood-recordings/events/1766123456/full.mp4 (auto-notify). :white_check_mark:
Eli - Events: Lina (editor) will grab clips as soon as VTT ready. Tori will review highlight captions.
Tori (Content): For the confirmation email please include calendar ICS and a one-line summary plus link to privacy + consent. Also include a short note for panelists with dial-in and rehearsal time.
Maya (Demand): final checks before we launch registration: A/B flag for CTA enabled?, Zap test ok?, GA event firing?, consent checkbox present?
Noah (Growth): I'll run a test reg and validate the Zap creates a test lead with utm. Scheduling note: I'll audit first-touch attribution after 24h.
Eli - Events: Launch checklist: reg page live 705, CTA A/B flags turned on 705, Zoom config verified 705, Zap webhook tested 705, clips owner assigned (Lina) 705.
Maya (Demand): awesome. Tagging @Felix for legal/ops final sign-off and @Noah for tracking validation.
Felix - Ops: signed off. Monitoring on standby during event.
Maya (Demand): thanks team 9— will post quick recap and ETA for clips when available. :tada:
